posts.title: From Words to Waypoints: Teaching a Small LLM to Plan for Robots
posts.description: Can a 9B open model learn to plan robot missions from temporal-logic specifications as well as a much larger one? Here’s the story of how we got there.

posts.title: A Gentle Introduction to PAC Learning
posts.description: Why should a model that fits a finite set of training examples do well on data it has never seen? Here’s a gentle tour of how the PAC framework answers that.

posts.title: About
